_comment: Full grid for the Session-48 graded-wall minimal-mass map. 2 improving cells from S47 x 4 extension depths (delta_frac = d/R1) x 5 density ratios q x 2 taper shapes + 2 d=0 baselines = 82 points. The S47 nested winner corresponds to ~(delta_frac 0.3, q 1.5, flat) at both cells; the grid asks whether deeper/denser/tapered grading beats it and where the continuous optimum sits. The thin-wall dfrac=0.25 cell is excluded (S47: structural negative -- splitting/extending strictly degrades it). NOTE the ~5 m canonical rho-smoothing partially smears taper shapes at these depths (d = 1.1-6 m); that is the canonical convention. Dispatch to jaga NUMA-aware (2 x numactl --cpunodebind=N --localalloc half-grids via --start/--stop; workers per the measured RAM cap and A/B result in machines cookbook).
